services.title: Window and door repairs for every type of property
services.description: Fourteen core services covering the mechanical, glazing and frame faults we are asked about most. Each one is a repair first, with replacement recommended only when it is genuinely the better outcome.

whyUs.title: A repair service built around the property and the people in it
whyUs.description: We are a specialist repair business rather than a window sales company, so the advice you receive is about fixing what you have.

process.title: From enquiry to finished repair in four clear steps
process.description: Every request follows the same straightforward process, whether it is a single stiff handle in a flat or a programme of repairs across a managed block.

areas.title: Window & Door Repairs Throughout London
areas.description: We serve residential and commercial customers across Greater London, from the centre out to the boroughs on every side. The districts below are the ones we are asked to attend most often; if your property is elsewhere within Greater London, please still get in touch.
areas.note: One team, London-wide. We do not operate branch offices; every enquiry is handled centrally and the repair is carried out at your property.

testimonials.title: What customers say about the work
testimonials.description: Feedback from the homeowners, landlords and businesses we have carried out repairs for across London.
testimonials.placeholderNotice: Sample content: these example quotes will be replaced with genuine customer feedback before launch.

pricing.title: Clear Quotations. Practical Repair Solutions.
pricing.description: We do not publish a price list because no two repairs are quite the same. Instead, every enquiry receives a written quotation that explains what the work involves and what it will cost before anything is agreed.
pricing.factorsHeading: What affects the cost of a repair

faq.title: Answers to the questions we hear most
faq.description: If your question is not covered here, include it in your enquiry and we will answer it alongside your quotation.
faq.buttonLabel: Ask a question with your enquiry

quote.title: Request a Window or Door Repair Quote
quote.description: Tell us a little about the repair you need and our team will review your enquiry.
quote.note: This form is our only enquiry channel. Keeping every request in one place means nothing is lost and each enquiry is reviewed by someone who understands window and door hardware.
quote.privacyLine: Your details are used only to respond to this enquiry.

cta.title: Ready to arrange a repair?
cta.description: Tell us about the window or door problem and we will review it and come back to you with a clear quotation.
